description: Agent Construction: submit a lien waiver with the payment record and the contract: the waiver with the waiving party, the party it was paid by, the owner, the project address, the waiver type (conditional or unconditional, progress or final), the amount, the through date and the day signed; the payment record with the payee, payer, amount, status (cleared, issued, pending or returned), the day paid, the last day of work it covers and whether it is the final amount; and optionally the contract with its number, owner, contractor and project address. The signed report gives the waiver, the payment record and the contract, the waiving party, the paying party, the owner and the address read against the records, the amount waived against the amount paid, the through date against the work paid for, and the waiver type against the payment’s standing, and counts them, and names a mismatched waiver: a waiving party unlike the payee, an amount unlike the payment, a through date past the work the payment covers, an unconditional waiver while the payment has not cleared or signed before it, a final waiver beside a progress amount, and a project address or owner unlike the contract; then a through date short of the work paid for, a conditional waiver after the payment cleared, another paying party and a signature before the through date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No contract, waiving party, amount, through date or payment status leaves the waiver unverified. Parties match without a legal suffix and amounts to the cent. A lien waiver is a payment document signed by a contractor or supplier: wever_realty-title-check flags open liens of record on a property title against the transaction it is read for, and wever_invoice-payment-match compares one invoice with one payment record, while the lien waiver check reads the waiving party, amount, through date and waiver type against the payment the waiver answers. Verdict build_lien_mismatched, build_lien_partial, build_lien_unverified or build_lien_matched. POST /api/build-lien-waiver-check. Reads the construction paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no structural, engineering or safety judgment, building-code compliance determination, valuation of work performed or legal advice on contracts, liens or permits, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Construction reads supplied construction paperwork for consistency between documents: a building permit, a contractor license record, a bid, a construction contract, a change order, a lien waiver, a completion certificate or punch list record, and a payment application. Beside it, wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there; and the Agent Real Estate checks such as wever_realty-title-check read property records by parcel and address, not a project’s construction paperwork. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-construction-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-construction/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

amount.description: The amount the record shows paid or to be paid.

final.description: Whether the record shows the final amount under the contract.

status.description: The status the record shows: cleared, issued, pending or returned.

through_on.description: The last day of work the record covers, such as 2026-06-12.

customer.description: The party the claimant was paid by, as printed.

through_on.description: The through date the waiver prints, such as 2026-06-12.

waiver_type.description: The waiver type as printed: conditional or unconditional, progress or final.

name: wever_build-lien-waiver-check
title: Construction lien waiver check
